items.t: FuelCell Energy Is Down 38% in a Month. What Will It Take to Get FCEL Stock Back to $10?
items.sum: FuelCell Energy surrendered most of its AI-fueled gains in weeks, and dilution is only part of the story. Two milestones, one Texas data center deal, and a pending earnings report may decide whether the rebound ever arrives.
